title: Lead Generation APIs Explained Across All Four Types
summary: Crustdata provides real-time B2B data API for AI agents with 1B+ people and 60M+ companies to power sales, recruiting, and investment workflows.
body_markdown: Chris writes about modern GTM strategy, signal-based selling, and the growing role of real-time intelligence across sales, recruiting, and investment workflows. At Crustdata, they focus on how live people and company insights help teams spot opportunities earlier, personalize outreach with context, and build stronger pipelines whether that’s sourcing talent, identifying high-potential startups, or closing deals faster.
